ValidationRule.description: For Half Day selection, From Date and To Date must be the same
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Day_Selection__c, "1st Half"), ISPICKVAL(Day_Selection__c, "2nd Half") ), NOT(ISBLANK( Start_Date__c )), NOT(ISBLANK( End_Date__c )), Start_Date__c <> End_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Half Day selection, From Date and To Date must be the same
